title: reward / training / information-boundary identity taxonomy v1 (v5-review P0-2; owner ruling 2 2026-07-18)
unit: method_path (one row per method path, NEVER per paper — a paper with a prompt-only main path and an SFT variant gets two rows)

fields.core_weight_update: bool — are the core/policy model weights updated anywhere in the method path
fields.external_component_weight_update: bool — is ANY external component (controller/verifier/reward model/memory updater/encoder head) gradient-trained or fine-tuned for this path
fields.controller_program_or_config_optimized_o: bool — controller code/config/prompt/exemplars searched or selected using labeled data (dev/search/calibration gold)
fields.human_or_dev_label_model_selection: bool — human preferences or dev labels used to SELECT among fixed components (e.g. judger selection), without training
fields.deployment_label_access: bool — does the deployed loop read any gold labels at inference time (task-level, not test-item)
fields.test_item_gold_access: bool — does the CURRENT test item's gold enter any inference path (the project's 信息边界 red line)
fields.inference_external_new_information: bool — does the inference loop actively acquire external information beyond the input (web retrieval, external-model knowledge injection)
fields.score_type: enum — the selection/feedback signal family actually used at inference
fields.model_access_level: enum — deepest access the method needs on the generator/core
fields.explicit_candidate_pool_selection: bool (extension beyond reviewer minimum) — does the path select/prune over an explicit candidate pool (K-pool); needed for occupancy conjunctions
fields.includes_speech_audio: bool (extension) — does the path evaluate on speech/audio modality

derived.is_reward_guided: score_type in {verifiable_utility, rule_reward, learned_rm_prm, llm_judge, human_aligned_proxy} — i.e. a scalar/graded quality signal steers candidate selection/pruning/search; consensus_mbr and self_confidence_loglik are tracked separately, NOT excluded by renaming (v5-review Round D)
derived.is_all_system_training_free: NOT core_weight_update AND NOT external_component_weight_update (TF-Strict weight axis; label-dependence is a SEPARATE axis and does not flip this bit)
derived.is_project_strict_identity: is_all_system_training_free AND NOT controller_program_or_config_optimized_on_labels AND NOT human_or_dev_label_model_selection AND NOT deployment_label_access AND NOT test_item_gold_access AND NOT inference_external_new_information AND model_access_level == api_text_only (all-system-data-free: dev-label component selection also violates — v5-review Round D)

conflict_rules: dev/calibration/search gold => controller_program_or_config_optimized_on_labels or human_or_dev_label_model_selection; NEVER test_item_gold_access (v5-review Round D: dev-label dependence must not be reported as test leakage)
occupancy summaries must be computed from this table by conjunction of named fields; free-text '唯一/零项/全部' without a machine-recomputable conjunction is forbidden
a mixed-path paper is counted per method_path; paper-level single-value identity is forbidden

2026.findings-acl.1724#pipeline.note: Selective TTS: llm_judge score prunes explicit candidate pools — self-framed 'guided by reward signals'; renaming it out of the reward axis is forbidden

2605.08083#discovered-controller.note: AutoTTS: search-set gold optimizes controller; held-out untouched — dev-label dependence, not test leakage

2602.16485#calibrated-orchestration.note: Team of Thoughts: cross-calibration gold builds profiles/selects orchestrator; test gold isolated

2026.findings-acl.1243#closed-prompt-onl.note: DeepVerifier main path: prompt-only zero training BUT verification agent retrieves web evidence (new-info); the SFT open variant is a SEPARATE row
